Planes already in the air were allowed to land. Flightradar24 data mapped by meteorologist Ryan Hall shows about 2,160 passenger planes over the U.S. at 3:53 p.m. By 5:08 p.m., 778 were left. DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin called it a telecommunications outage and said there is no indication it was a threat to the United States.
